classification: Design failure scenarios, not confirmed vulnerabilities or executed tests.

scenarios.impact: Customer/financial data exposure or restricted mutation
scenarios.detection: Permission denials/access audit and direct-API tests
scenarios.prevention: Current server grant/scope/projection checks; reserved role authority
scenarios.recovery: Revoke affected access, investigate minimal evidence, repair policy and rerun denial cases
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Wrong market/no-read/inactive/custom managerial title/hidden search/download tests
scenarios.residualRisk: Auth provider, privacy and deployment controls not implemented
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Invariant monitor and ledger reconciliation
scenarios.prevention: Per-authority locks, unique refs/idempotency and exact immutable authority
scenarios.recovery: Freeze affected financial workflow; reconcile external outcome before authorised correction
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Final-available race, unknown72/fail72/retry, rejected amendment restore
scenarios.residualRisk: No automatic uncertain payment retry; final-fact correction policy open
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Receipt races waiver or inspection changes
scenarios.impact: Waived physical goods or lost receipt truth
scenarios.detection: Receipt version/scope conflict and balance/audit review
scenarios.prevention: RMA root lock, immutable physical events, stale waiver supersession
scenarios.recovery: Retain accepted order/history; fresh waiver against current balance; explicit reopen for late arrival
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Both race orders, partial/zero receipt, damaged and late received item
scenarios.residualRisk: Correction/inspection exception rules still owner decisions
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Domain closure blockers and reconciliation
scenarios.prevention: All writers lock ticket; independent domain-state plus task gates
scenarios.recovery: Reopen with authority and preserve previous resolution; fulfil actual obligations
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Each gate, missing dispute task, concurrent obligation create
scenarios.residualRisk: No implementation/race evidence yet
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Shared contact/alias ambiguity or competing correction
scenarios.detection: Identity conflict cases and source/audit review
scenarios.prevention: Full canonical identity, deliberate person choice, collision locks/versions
scenarios.recovery: Hold ambiguous work; approved correction without deleting identities/history
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Household duplicates, suffix discovery, aliases and concurrent proposals
scenarios.residualRisk: Real merge disabled; source identity evidence may be incomplete
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Role change/new assignment strands work or final admin
scenarios.detection: Access impact preview, current eligibility and admin audit
scenarios.prevention: Shared/exclusive policy guard, last-admin and eligible handover checks
scenarios.recovery: Use authorised retained admin path; handover without resetting missed deadline
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Concurrent admins, grant union, wrong-scope and new-task race
scenarios.residualRisk: Delegated privilege policy/contact roster unapproved
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Export link or file access after revocation
scenarios.detection: Download audit/expiry and access anomaly
scenarios.prevention: Reauthorise generation/download, stable snapshot/projection, private files
scenarios.recovery: Revoke tickets/objects as authorised; assess copies and privacy impact
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Lost scope before download, formula-safe Unicode full-set CSV
scenarios.residualRisk: Started transfers/copies cannot be recalled; retention policy open
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Scan state/timeouts/checksum/type mismatch
scenarios.prevention: Quarantine until clean; server size/type/hash; least-privilege storage
scenarios.recovery: Keep object quarantined, retry bounded scan or reject; never bypass scanner
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Spoofed MIME/oversize/hash mismatch/failed scan download denial
scenarios.residualRisk: Actual scanner/limits/provider unselected
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Outbox age, inbox/dedupe, job lag/DLQ
scenarios.prevention: Transactional source/outbox/task; idempotent consumer leases
scenarios.recovery: Reconcile accepted effect; replay same event safely; retain missed evidence
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Crash before/after send/mark/effect/ack and out-of-order stale revision
scenarios.residualRisk: No exactly-once network promise; runtime unimplemented
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Dependency health, lock/pool metrics and error rates
scenarios.prevention: Bounded pools/timeouts, deterministic locks, idempotent transient retries
scenarios.recovery: Preserve draft, reconnect/retry same key when safe; investigate saturation
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Unavailable DB, deadlock retry budget, no partial transaction
scenarios.residualRisk: Availability/capacity targets open
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.impact: Login/service access failures or unsafe fallback
scenarios.detection: Provider auth errors, expiry/config validation
scenarios.prevention: Fail closed; known session/current-user policy and safe config
scenarios.recovery: Recover approved provider/config/keys, revoke exposures; never bypass auth
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Expired/altered token, provider down, missing config and recovery reuse
scenarios.residualRisk: Provider/session/contact policy open
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Latency/errors/CPU/memory/disk/pool/queue/cost alerts
scenarios.prevention: Body/file/page bounds, backpressure and measured limits
scenarios.recovery: Shed optional heavy work per policy, scale only approved resources, reconcile jobs
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Bounded load/soak,429,queue flood,memory/disk pressure
scenarios.residualRisk: No production load profile or cost thresholds yet
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Restore reference/checksum/count/ledger reconciliation
scenarios.prevention: Coordinated DB/object backups, key recovery and isolated drill
scenarios.recovery: Stop live resumption; restore consistent point or approved forward repair
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Missing objects, audit/task/outbox mismatch and duplicate replay
scenarios.residualRisk: RPO/RTO/retention and infrastructure unapproved
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Stale/replayed import or missing historical facts
scenarios.impact: Duplicate records or overwrite newer work
scenarios.detection: Batch disposition/source mapping/count and finance reconciliation
scenarios.prevention: Source-ID dedupe, target versions, ambiguity quarantine and unknown coverage
scenarios.recovery: Hold conflicts; reconcile reviewed rows; no fabricated history/backfill
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Same/older batch after live edit, incomplete dates/actors/opening balances
scenarios.residualRisk: Actual legacy source not supplied
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Compromised dependency/CI action or leaked secret
scenarios.detection: Reviewed lockfile/action provenance/scans and suspicious access
scenarios.prevention: Least privilege, full-SHA actions, secret store, no privileged PR jobs
scenarios.recovery: Stop promotion, revoke/rotate, trace source/artifacts, rebuild reviewed release
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Secret-pattern fixture and future scanner/provenance injection tests
scenarios.residualRisk: Heuristic is incomplete; hosted CI/supply-chain scanners absent
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Time coverage/invariant checks and clock telemetry
scenarios.prevention: UTC instants + explicit business zone, deterministic clocks, actual vs recorded
scenarios.recovery: Correct through audited authorised event; keep raw observation
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: IST midnight fractional second, exact due equality, reschedule/backdated completion
scenarios.residualRisk: Production business calendar/backdating policy open
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Staging migration/smoke/version/health checks
scenarios.prevention: Expand-contract, immutable artifact, migration sequencing and abort gates
scenarios.recovery: Compatible artifact rollback or reviewed forward repair/restore; reconcile side effects
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Old/new versions overlap, partial migration and rollback drill
scenarios.residualRisk: No actual app/CI/runtime deployment exists
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Immutable requester/approver/scope/evidence audit and management review
scenarios.prevention: Keep exact authority/amount/quantity/version/assent and current-scope checks
scenarios.recovery: Investigate under approved management policy; do not rewrite historical decision
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Own-request eligible succeeds; ordinary CS/wrong-market remains blocked
scenarios.residualRisk: User explicitly accepts self-approval behavior; fraud/audit review policy may evolve
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.detection: Provider receipt/correlation/reconciliation and job alerts
scenarios.prevention: Separate phase, provider-specific signatures/idempotency/timeouts/limits
scenarios.recovery: Hold uncertain funds/action; query verified provider status before retry
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Future adapter isolated timeout/429/5xx/duplicate/conflicting event fixtures
scenarios.residualRisk: No external execution integration enabled at manual launch
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Invalid, malformed or oversized request reaches the business logic
scenarios.impact: A rejected write leaves a partial or forged business effect, or validation gaps become an authorisation bypass path
scenarios.detection: Per-endpoint rejected-request counts, schema validation failures and invariant monitors
scenarios.prevention: Schema/length/type allowlists at the trust boundary, discriminated commands and explicit error envelopes
scenarios.recovery: Reject the request, confirm no accepted effect exists, correct the contract and re-test the boundary
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Malformed, oversized, unknown-field and wrong-type payloads against every command and query
scenarios.residualRisk: No application boundary exists yet; request validation enforcement is NOT IMPLEMENTED
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Partial transaction or torn multi-record write
scenarios.impact: Business facts, audit history and task state disagree; money, receipt or waiver totals become unexplainable
scenarios.detection: Invariant monitors, row-count reconciliation and audit-to-ledger comparison
scenarios.prevention: One database transaction per command, no best-effort second write, outbox written with the business change
scenarios.recovery: Roll back or forward-repair the affected transaction, re-run reconciliation and replay only idempotent work
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Injected failure between writes, rollback assertions, restartability and post-recovery reconciliation
scenarios.residualRisk: Requires real PostgreSQL failure injection; no application or database exists
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Storage, memory or database connection exhaustion
scenarios.impact: Service degradation, stranded jobs or failed saves presented to users as business failures
scenarios.detection: Disk, memory and pool-saturation metrics, pool wait time, queue age and outbox lag alarms
scenarios.prevention: Bounded file, page, export and request sizes, pool budgets, backpressure and explicit shedding of optional work
scenarios.recovery: Extend approved capacity or shed explicitly, drain safely and resume without duplicate effects
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Disk near-full, memory pressure and pool exhaustion under a bounded load profile
scenarios.residualRisk: Capacity envelope and budget ceiling are recorded (D-12), but shedding thresholds and load tooling are not selected
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json

scenarios.failureCondition: Corrupted, tampered or unreadable stored data
scenarios.impact: Wrong balances, histories or evidence are presented as trustworthy and drive incorrect decisions
scenarios.detection: Constraint and checksum verification, reconciliation, restore integrity checks and anomaly review
scenarios.prevention: Foreign keys, check constraints, append-only evidence, checksums for files and exports, controlled migrations
scenarios.recovery: Restore from a verified point or repair from immutable history, then re-reconcile balances and audit continuity
scenarios.plannedTestCoverage: Checksum mismatch, truncated record and tampered-row cases on seeded data
scenarios.residualRisk: Database-level tamper detection and privileged operator controls are not implemented
scenarios.owner: Relevant domain owner + technical/operations/security owner; individuals named in docs/governance/ownership.json
